detail.longDescription: The new field of optogenetics won the Nobel Prize for Physiology and Medicine. Very cool technique to switch genes on and off with light. I recall I began writing about it sometime around 2004 and had a bunch of conversations with one of its inventors, Karl Deisseroth - now a Nobel winner. I miss my career sometimes but I don't really miss the 5 am October wake-ups to do Nobel Prize stories. # research # medicine # science https://www. nobelprize.org/
